english.note: This is the all-purpose term for bribery and abuse of power in government or business.
Use this for corruption in public or official life.

examples.english: This corruption case ruined the whole company’s reputation.
examples.traditional: 呢單貪污案搞到成間公司冇晒信譽。

examples.english: He was arrested by the ICAC for graft involving public funds.
examples.traditional: 佢涉嫌貪污公款，最後畀廉署拉咗。
